items.statement: Expanding global pooling to offset interest payments.

items.statement: Capacity shifts may cause port congestion and supply chain disruptions.

items.statement: Higher demand and rates help increase volumes and revenues.

items.statement: Expect good results in all three categories within this year from IDS leads.
items.quote: And we expect that within this year, we will see good results in all three categories. And this momentum will keep carrying forward for the next two years because some registration takes three months once we have products and services that we want to sell.

items.statement: Aligner category capacity utilization is 67%.
items.quote: Mathematical analysis, it will be 67% capacity utilization in the aligner category. That is how, what we are currently.

items.statement: Zirconia contributes more than 50% of domestic laboratory revenue and significant majority of export revenue.
items.quote: So Zirconia contributes, I would say significant majority or depends on the domestic part it's more than 50% in terms of revenue. On the export part there is a significant majority of Zirconia because there are other products as well that we do in the international market.

items.statement: Digitization can eliminate 25% to 30% of processes.
items.quote: And that is the goal right now, you know, the digitization, like I said, happy for you to come see the process , we can eliminate 25% to 30% processes with digitization and that is what is our constant strive to do.

items.statement: Expects quarterly growth similar to last year, with numbers multiplying as they go ahead.
items.quote: But one thing I can say is that there will be a quarterly growth like the way we did it last year. So that's the trend that we'll be currently committing right now. And as and when we go ahead, the numbers will only multiply.

items.statement: Won 6 new orders worth over INR100 crores over next 4-5 years, including Central Bank of India deal.
items.quote: When it comes to technology partner business, I can say that today, in about last 4, 5 months odd with all the efforts from my sales team, we got 6 new orders worth over INR100-odd crores in the next 4 to 5 years.

items.statement: Central Bank of India order is about INR70-odd crore over next 5 years.
items.quote: One of the largest deal being Central Bank of India, which is majorly because we ensured that we pivot into more areas of business and offline payment was one, which is about INR70-odd crore order in the next 5 years.

items.statement: New businesses will start showing numbers in P&L by first half of FY26.
items.quote: For all the new businesses, which I mentioned, our P&L will start showing the numbers from -- by the half yearly -- first half yearly itself in FY '26.

items.statement: Payment platform expected to return to 70-odd percent revenue share this financial year.
items.quote: And then -- so we see that we anticipate our payment platform to be going back to the same 70-odd percent revenue share this financial year, coming from 65% to 70%-odd from this particular business.

items.statement: Africa deal revenue will start hitting from Q1, with 7-8 months execution period.
items.quote: And so the execution has already started this quarter. We are expecting this is going to be 7, 8 months execution period, but the revenue will start hitting from Q1 itself and because there are milestone-based payments.

items.statement: Expects higher number in Q1 and Q2, benchmarking highest ever achieved.
items.quote: I can definitely look at a higher number coming in from Q1, Q2. But to be honest, if you benchmark it with the -- no, not exactly. So if you benchmark it with the highest number ever achieved by the company in those 2 quarters, I believe that the role is definitely going there only, if that's the direction.

items.statement: Committed quarter-on-quarter, annual, and half-yearly growth.
items.quote: I said I have committed quarter-on-quarter growth to you, I've committed annual growth also, half yearly growth also, but benchmarking it certain number -- is something that, let the results -- as and when the results come, we can do that.

items.statement: Proportion of GMV eligible for interchange will remain same, but ticket size will go down.
items.quote: That proportion will remain same, but the ticket size will go down. The proportion will remain the same.

items.statement: Per transaction realization may decrease, but volume will increase massively.
items.quote: Yes, the cost -- let's say, if your reconciliation cost is INR0.05, I may get INR0.03 or I may get about INR0.04, but the volume will increase. That is majorly because of the increase in volume happening in the market.

items.statement: MDR will increase upward as new instruments add value to the system.
items.quote: And yes, MDR will hit the business, I mean, upward and that will come as and when the instruments start adding value to the system.

items.statement: Q3 was worst and is behind us now.
items.quote: Well, I would say that Q3 was worst. It's behind us now. We have taken time.

items.statement: Talent pool to increase by about 30% incrementally, with AI implementation.
items.quote: Last year, there were about 20% addition in our talent pool. And this year, the estimated upward trend is going to be about 30-odd percent incremental talent along with the AI implementation.

items.statement: About 60-65% of new talent deployed in tech and product domain.
items.quote: So I feel that about 60%-odd, 60%, 65% or maybe more will be the tech and product domain. I think about 30%-odd of that, maybe 10%, 15% will be around sales.

items.statement: RegTech market size estimated at $2 billion for their type of service provider.
items.quote: So basis the module that we have developed right now, there is a $2 billion market size. Now it can be -- as and when the module multiplies and the market evolves, it can go beyond that also.

items.statement: Working with 3 to 4 channel partners for global expansion.
items.quote: So we have about 3 to 4 channel partners with whom we are working day in and out.
